description: This header file defines the WebPA Abstraction APIs related to libparodus, including functions for setting notify config, managing client connections, stopping receive threads, and sending notifications.

methods.name: libpd_set_notifyConfigFile
methods.description: Sets the initial notify configuration files for libparodus.

methods.name: libpd_client_mgr
methods.description: Initializes the libparodus client connection and loads the database.

methods.name: stop_parodus_recv_wait
methods.description: Stops the parodus receive wait thread.

methods.name: sendNotification
methods.description: Sends a notification message with specified payload, source, and destination.
